d:
Hazen Audel takes on a perilous solo journey through one of North America's deepest canyons. Facing lethal animals, steep cliffs, plunging chasms and extreme heat, he must navigate treacherous terrain while relying on traditional techniques to complete his challenging expedition.
Survival expert Hazen Audel takes on the planet’s toughest environments, from dense jungles to frozen wildernesses, using traditional survival skills, courage and instinct to overcome nature’s most extreme challenges.
